title: Polaritonic machine learning for graph-based data analysis
summary: This article proposes a polaritonic machine learning approach using lattices of condensates to embed relational information from point cloud datasets. The method integrates photonic processing with convolutional neural networks, achieving over 90% accuracy in Betti number classification and clique detection tasks compared to 35% for bare CNNs. Published on Physical review. E by researchers at the University of Exeter and University of Sheffield.
tldr: A study demonstrates polaritonic systems improving graph-based data analysis accuracy through physics-informed feature engineering integrated with digital machine learning pipelines.
evidence: Photonic and polaritonic systems offer a fast and efficient platform for accelerating machine learning (ML) through physics-based computing.

Our extensive benchmarking shows that photonic machine learning achieves over 90% accuracy for Betti number classification and clique detection tasks, a substantial improvement over the 35% accuracy of bare CNNs.
